description: Reads a CSV export from Strackr or a network (Impact, Awin, CJ, ShareASale, Rakuten, ShopMy…). A programs export (advertisers with a status) adds each to progress as applied, accepted or declined; a transactions export adds orders and amounts to each brand's sales, for results_get. The same rows imported twice count once.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: brand_programs_import
title: Import programs or sales
